children: The S&P Global Japan Manufacturing PMI was confirmed at 54.1 in September 2026, matching the preliminary estimate and easing from 54.9 in the previous month, marking the ninth consecutive month of expansion in factory activity.
It was the softest expansion in the manufacturing sector since March, as firms recorded slower increases in output and new orders.
Output growth eased to a three-month low, as firms recorded sales growth at its weakest in four months.
The slowdown came despite a further marked increase in foreign sales, although the rate of growth eased from August's eight-and-a-half-year high.

title: Japan Manufacturing Growth at 6-Month Low, Confirmed
